source_caption_text:
Bro was way too convincing in this role 😭

Via @netflix

Back in 2018, Kendrick Lamar made a surprise appearance on the Starz crime drama Power, taking on the role of Laces, a fast-talking hustler struggling with addiction. Instead of playing himself or making a quick celebrity cameo, Kendrick asked 50 Cent for a chance to play a dr*g addict. His appearance came in the Season 5 episode “Happy Birthday,” where he shared several scenes with 50 Cent’s character, Kanan.

What made the role so memorable was how different Kendrick looked and acted from the superstar fans were used to seeing. With messy hair, worn-out clothes and unpredictable mannerisms, he fully committed to the character. He even worked Spanish into his dialogue, bringing a level of detail that made Laces feel like someone who belonged in the world of Power.

Kendrick received plenty of praise for the performance, but he never returned to the show or really pursued another scripted TV role. It’s still wild to think that he stepped into Power for one episode, delivered a performance people are still talking about years later, and went straight back to making music.
